design.event_group: predicate plus unordered candidate entity pair
design.event_bootstrap: 1000 within-condition resamples of seed-mean event-group scores, trained runs fixed
design.training_interval: two-sided t interval over five run means
design.contrasts: four post-result contrasts, common seed labels as blocks, Holm-adjusted descriptive p-values; no confirmatory claim

surface_noise_comparison.note: Two fixed surface realizations on shared semantic groups; difference is not a confidence interval over future noise realizations.
